exposure: Number of pregnancies and children (three and more)
cohort: The study included 1318 non-first-born newborns from neonatal intensive care and delivery units, all of whom had older siblings.
finding: Pre-labour CS, maternal asthma, GA, babies with large and small birth weight for GA, number of pregnancies and children (three and more), and siblings' asthma were all found to be independently associated with a diagnosis of TTN.
mod_finding: Pre-labour caesarean section was identified as a common risk factor significantly associated with the development of TTN.
birth_weight: Birth weight was a measured variable, and babies with large and small birth weight for gestational age were specifically analyzed.
gest_age: Gestational age at birth was a measured variable in the study.
